resources.string: Start a headless wlroots desktop inside a container and view it natively. Install labwc (or another compatible compositor) and wayvnc first. GNOME, KDE and Weston are not supported by wayvnc. Pinch to zoom, use two fingers to scroll, or enable Pan to move the viewport.
Connect to an existing VNC server

Container sessions listen only on 127.0.0.1. Existing servers may use legacy VNC password authentication (first 8 password bytes, no transport encryption). Unauthenticated connections are allowed only on loopback.
